**Section A: confirmed-real findings (P0)**
- The lambda-magnitude confound is real and correctly diagnosed. `lambda_matched_random_phi` in `joint_graph_state` uses exactly `lam = 0.20 + 0.40·|I_ij|` (identical to `incidence_derived`), with only phi randomized. This isolates the previously undetected distribution mismatch (mean Δλ ≈ +0.176).
- Ising admission (+7.16 z) collapses to z ≈ 0 under the matched control; this was entirely a confound.
- Noisy-half B.1 sign-reversal effect is chance-level (5/12 flips) under matched control.
- The 7-round failure to detect the confound is explained by the phi-dominated nature of XY/Heisenberg entanglers and the absence of any matched-lambda control mode until R7-prep.

**Section B: overclaims (P1)**
- "The most consequential finding of the entire 7-round audit loop" is an overclaim. The confound is consequential for the bridge probe but does not automatically rank above root-stack, carrier, or capacity findings across the full audit.
- Residual B.1 claim (10/12 pure flips, p ≈ 0.019) is overclaimed. It cherry-picks a 3-functional subset from a 20-cell space (5 functionals × 4 cells) without Bonferroni/FDR correction or explicit selection-bias acknowledgment. Effect-size collapse (~5×) and noisy-half null make the "residual phi-structure component" framing unsupported.
- Implicit absolute verdict "no signal under matched control" overstates the result; K=30 SE leaves room for undetected small effects.

**Section C: gaps (P2)**
- No explicit multiple-testing correction or full 20-cell re-analysis for the residual B.1 p-value.
- No power/SE caveat attached to the matched-control null (small signals remain possible below K=30 detection threshold).
- Silent retractions (Ising admission, noisy-half B.1, prior z=+7.16 claims) are not exhaustively flagged in every prior-round reference.
- No systematic check for analogous unmatched-parameter confounds in earlier rounds.

**Section D: severity-ranked recommendations**
1. (P1) Retract or heavily qualify the residual B.1 claim; report only the full 20-cell corrected result or drop the "phi-structure component" language.
2. (P1) Remove or downgrade the "most consequential finding of the entire 7-round audit loop" sentence.
3. (P2) Add explicit power/SE language to the "no signal under matched control" verdict.
4. (P2) Add a one-paragraph "silent retractions" subsection listing exactly which prior claims are invalidated by the confound fix.
5. (P2) Run a quick audit pass on R1–R6 for any other unmatched entangler-parameter distributions.

**Section E: FIXED-POINT VERDICT (loop converged: YES / NO)**  
NO

R8 returns P1 overclaims; two-consecutive-clean criterion not met.
